subject: Future Tech
title: Trapped Ion Machines
description: A fast breakdown of Trapped Ion Machines for builders.

hook.text: Trapped ion quantum computers use individual atoms suspended in electromagnetic fields as their qubits.

buildup.text: Lasers manipulate each ion's energy levels. Different energy states represent 0 and 1.

discovery.text: IonQ built a trapped-ion machine with error rates that rival any superconducting competitor.

twist.text: Trapped ions have longer coherence times than superconducting qubits, but gate operations run much slower.

climax.text: The trade-off is clear: trapped ions are accurate but slow; superconductors are fast but error-prone.

punchline.text: Atoms make patient, precise quantum processors.

quiz.question: What holds the ions in place in a trapped ion computer?
